concern_text: Fully-remote B2B SaaS in CA, 12 W-2 staff plus 1099 contractors, sells auto-renewing subscriptions, collects customer data online. Hurt by changes to subscription/cancellation rules, data privacy/breach notice, worker classification, overtime thresholds, mandated benefits. Does NOT sell physical goods, import, or handle food, and does not collect data from children under 13.
